faqs.question: Which Medical fields offer the best work-life balance?
faqs.answer:
Some medical field which offe best work and life balance are shown below -
Dentistry (BDS & MDS) – Fixed clinic hours, fewer emergencies.
Pharmacy (BPharm & MPharm) – Less stress compared to hospital-based jobs.
Physiotherapy (BPT & MPT) – Flexible working hours, minimal emergency calls.
Public Health & Community Medicine – Focus on preventive healthcare rather than emergency treatments.
Clinical Research & Medical Writing – Research-based work with no direct patient responsibilities.

placements.overview: NIMS Institute of Pharmacy, NIMS University is a private institute in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The institute is approved by the PCI. At the UG, PG and Doctorate levels, the institute offers 7 courses across 2 specialisations in Full Time mode. The popular NIMS Institute of Pharmacy, NIMS University programs include B.Pharma, M.Pharma, Ph.D., D.Pharma and Pharm.D. NIMS Institute of Pharmacy, NIMS University courses are provided in several streams including Medicine & Health Sciences, etc. The institute has a total seat intake of 221 students. The fees at NIMS Institute of Pharmacy, NIMS University ranges between INR 1,20,000 to 13,00,000 for the different courses. The institute has a well-laid infrastructure with multiple facilities.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: NIMS Institute of Pharmacy, NIMS University provides Full Time programs at the UG and PG levels. These courses are available in stream like Medicine & Health Sciences, and have a fee structure of around INR 1,20,000 to 13,00,000. UG programs include B.Pharma and D.Pharma. Further, the PG programs include M.Pharma.

KIET Ghaziabad Application Process 2026

Students can apply online at the official site of KIET Ghaziabad. To complete the process, students need to submit the application with documents and fees before the last date of admission. The university then verifies the submitted documents.
Entrance Examination Scores

KIET Ghaziabad selects candidates based on their scores in entrance exams such as JEE Main, CUET, GPAT, CAT, etc. Before applying students must check the minimum eligibility of the programme at the university and make sure that those are met. Check the entrance examination that is accepted for selection and appear for the same.
Selection Process

The admission committee screens candidates and shortlists them on the basis of the respective entrance exam scores and if the eligibility requirement is met. Students have to appear for national-level exams and meet theKIET University cutoffto be eligible.
Admission Confirmation

Shortlisted candidates will be extended the provisional admission confirmation and must confirm their admission by paying theKIET Ghaziabad fees. Admitted students need to complete academic registration and come for the university orientation programme.

The university accepts entrance exam scores for courses such as BTech, MTech, MBA, MPharm, etc. Candidates can also get admission based on their qualifying exam scores in few programmes. Selected aspirants have to confirm their seat by paying the course fees after of all the rounds are done.

faqs.question: What are the courses offered at KIET deemed-to-be University?
faqs.answer: KIET deemed-to-be University offers several programmes at UG, PG, and PhD levels. These are all offered in full-time mode. Students can pursue the following programmes:BTechMTechMBAMCAMPharmaBPharmaDPharmaPhD

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in KIET for BTech?
faqs.answer: KIET, Ghaziabad BTech admissions are entrance-based. The admission on 85% of the total seats are for students who qualify the JEE Main entrance exam. For the remaining 15% seats, candidates are given option of getting admission via Management quota seats (direct admission) for its BTech programme. These management quota seats are filled at the institute level based on the merit scores obtained by students in Class 12 with PCM followed by a written test and personal interview. Additionally, the final seats are allocated through UPTAC Counselling process.

placement_data.title: KIET University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The Corporate Relations and Placement Centre at KIET University aims to assist students in defining their educational and career objectives, while also providing them with job-seeking skills to secure their dream job. Additionally, the highest package recorded for MBA and MCA recorded during KIET University placements stood at INR 16.72 LPA and INR 16.42 LPA, respectively. Some of the top recruiters were Deloitte, Amazon, Accenture, Wipro, Infosys, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is a bit small, but infrastructure-wise good, too good a football ground.
reviews.review_text: All labs are equipped with Wi-Fi and cameras, as well as classrooms and a library. There's a well-equipped library as well, with full AC, and all classrooms have 3 AC's. I live in a hostel, so I can answer better. The quality of food is good, sometimes food is so bad, sometimes too good. Some hostel also has sports facilities, so overall okay.

reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean and have projectors. Computer labs are updated with the latest software. faqs.question: Q: How is life at KJ Somaiya Medical College?

faqs.answer: Admission to the MBBS programme at KJ Somaiya Medical College is determined by both entrance and merit. Entry-level:The National Eligibility and Entrance Test, or NEET, is the main entrance exam. To get into KJ Somaiya, one must do well on the NEET. NEET is given more weight, but Maharashtra applicants may also be evaluated under the state quota. Merit-based:Your chances of getting a seat at KJ Somaiya are based on your ranking in the NEET and/or Maharashtra NEET merit list.Your chances of being chosen are increased the higher your rank.Seat allocation is determined by your rank, selected course and college, category, and application quota (All India or state).The admissions process at KJ Somaiya is essentially entrance- and merit-based since it ranks applicants according to their performance on a standardized entrance exam (NEET) and then distributes seats in accordance with that ranking.Recall that your top priority should continue to be achieving a high NEET and/or Maharashtra NEET score in order to improve your chances of being admitted to this esteemed medical school.

paragraphs: BIT Mesra course admissionsare done based on the scores of the aspirants in accepted entrance exams. The admission procedure is a multi-level process, which includes application form filling, selection rounds, offline admission process, and document verification. Below are the steps:
BITS Mesra Application Process 2026

The application process for all courses at BITS Mesra is conducted out in online mode. Candidates can apply through the institute's official website for the desired course. Further, aspirants shall ensure that they submit their application within the deadline.
BITS Mesra Selection Process 2026
Depending upon the applied course, candidates are required to appear for the respective entrance exam, Writing Ability Test, and personal interview round.
Release of Merit List
The results of the selection rounds are published in the form of a merit list on the official website. Shortlisted candidates further have to appear for WAT-PI rounds.

hostel.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA
reviews.review_text: Many equipment in the labs are damaged but still being used. The Wi-Fi connection is very good, giving a high-speed network of up to 100 Mbps. The library is quite disappointing as books are in bad condition and there are not enough facilities, and there is no AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Civil maatt lo CSE, mech, ECE, EEE are good options.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The campus is big and full of greenery, and it has good vibes in terms of nature. The buildings are also good, but the hostels and their Wi-Fi are not good, as Wi-Fi is down most of the time, due to which I recommend that you take a backup plan for Wi-Fi for yourself.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews.review_heading: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good Wi-Fi connection inside the campus, like in the hostel, classrooms, and labs. The classrooms are very clean, with AC, projectors, and well-ventilated. The labs are also good. We have a lab for every course. The hostels are neat and clean. Every day, the hostels are cleaned and the washrooms also, but the hostel rooms are to be cleaned by the students after that particular room.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with above average placement for both circuit and non-circuit branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi inside the campus is good, high-speed, but it fluctuates a lot, sometimes it gives 150 mbps and other times it goes down to kbps, so it's unpredictable. Labs have all the required equipment available, some equipment does need changes, and it is either broken or old, but overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in CSE are good, but for ECE, they are the worst. Good coding culture in college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very small. In the first year, hostel rooms are still big, but from the second year, their size is very small. In a room, 2 students are present, which is something that I don't like about this college. There are also some three-sharing rooms in the hostel, and they are pretty good, but only a few students get them. Wi-Fi is average, like those students whose rooms are in the corners of the hostel didn't get much access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are 10/10, like they are very good. La...

reviews.review_heading: A very good college but you have to spend 10 lakhs in 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, it is having large number of books. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Boys hostel is 4 to 5 km away from the college. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend Birla Institute of Technology Mesra.
reviews.review_text: The food menu is decided by the student body living in that. Home-like food in some hostels, like H5, is great. Any problem, we have Dean sir, for student affairs. If anyone is behaving rudely, you can talk to sir, and you do not need any other proof.

reviews.review_heading: Placement varies every year. Infrastructure and environment are good. Faculty depends on the course.
reviews.review_text: Management is questionable but the infrastructure is quite good. Hostel rooms are kind of small for two students but you will get used to them in no time. The Wi-Fi is available all around the campus so its a plus point. Sports facilities are decent. Dispensary provide free medicine.

reviews.review_heading: I am neither dissatisfied nor satisfied, but happy with what I got.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big, but it has great potential to be one of the greatest campuses in India. Many places on the campus are only trees, and all that's good because the AQI is good on the campus. Still, there are places where much infrastructure can be built.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for circuit courses in B.Tech and for mechanical engineering only.
reviews.review_text: The library, playgrounds, and classrooms are good with AC and smartboards. Hostels aren't that good, with quite small rooms, but we would adjust. Food in the mess is okay, and Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are all well-equipped, and we won't face any problem regarding that. Apart from that, the campus is very beautiful and pollution-free with a lot of trees.

reviews.review_heading: It has heart-welcoming infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm proud to be a part of the biggest university, with versatile facilities and well-known for its service. The management would provide liberty for the students' movement to take part in any of the activities, like sports, college events, internships, or visits. Students' suggestions are appreciated and welcome.

reviews.review_heading: The review of the social work department at Royal Global University.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi in every teacher's staff room. Library is very useful for students who need to work, and it is easily accessible to all students with a good network. In every corner, there is Wi-Fi available, even when the network is down, students can make use of it.

reviews.review_heading: The Assam Royal Global University is a diamond hidden in the dumps of Assam.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, canteens, and infrastructures are of top-notch quality, and the quality of food is reasonable, but one thing that struck me is that the whole university campus is vegetarian. So non-vegetarian food may be a little bit difficult to find, but the taste is not bad.

reviews.review_heading: College experience is nice and it will help to build your future.
reviews.review_text: The staffs were very nice. College provided all the requirements of the students like AC, fan, and proper ventilation. The hostel facilities were very good in terms of behaviour. The food was nice and they also provided sports-related things which could help students to freshen their minds in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure include full AC service across the entire university, with a huge auditorium, banking services, classrooms and studios, fine arts studio, fashion studios, incubation centre, legal facilities, moot court, etc. Hostel facilities are also good, with separate accommodations for boys and girls, and the food is totally amazing.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university for M.Sc. in zoology course.
reviews.review_text: Campus Wi-Fi and infrastructure were mediocre. The zoology department had decent classrooms and an open library. The hostel was mediocre. The quality of mess meal was subpar. The college also offered games and sports. Although it was located far from the department, the hostel was there. It's not decent food.

reviews.review_heading: The course is decent. Some things could be better, but overall it's above average.
reviews.review_text: RGU has a good infrastructure for my course. We have a dedicated animation lab and a classroom. Most of the work is done on our laptops, and we are provided with a well-equipped space that includes plug points. The campus also offers good common rooms, sports facilities, classrooms, and food canteens.

reviews.review_heading: This university has the best infrastructure in the North East, along with good education quality.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is amazing. I don’t think there is any other university in the entire Northeast with this kind of infrastructure. In my field of Biotechnology, I can say it’s a good place to study, with high-tech laboratory facilities and practical sessions.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is great for teaching, classes, extracurricular activities, festivals, events, etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Diagnostic laboratory, classroom, hostel, library, canteen, and doctor room are available. Medical facilities, sports, and mess are available. Our college is one of the best colleges in Assam for infrastructure. It is very helpful for us.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college and I will recommend students to take admission.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good, and the food provided in the mess is acceptable. I find the hostel food to be lacking in taste. As for sports, my college is commendable since it offers a variety of indoor and outdoor activities. There is a varsity week every year.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is very good, comfortable, and peaceful for studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel accommodation was great, providing many facilities and hygienic food. Daily cleaning of rooms was provided, along with 24-hour electricity supply and clean water. The food quality was also good, and a variety of the Menu was provided during the week. The hostel fee was Rs.2,10,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Really good faculty (500+), good infrastructure, events, and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms have their personalised ACs. In hostels, only veg is allowed. The campus keeps various traditions in mind. We have 4+ cafeterias on our campus along with a desert bar, dominos, and more. Many blocks are being constructed and more hostels as well.

reviews.review_heading: Really good campus, for sure a good college life and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is one of the best in Ghy. Royal is well known for its good campus and top-class infrastructure. Hostels are way too good. We have added a swimming pool and gym this year. The campus is totally veg, and no non-veg items are allowed inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best University for M.Sc. in Mathematics Course.
reviews.review_text: The food in the hotel is delicious, and as the pandemic continues, we don’t need to go out and buy our food. They bring breakfast, lunch, and dinner to our room. The architecture is fantastic, and there are plenty of vantage points on the RGU roof, which looks amazing. Since RGU is located in Assam, it has a lot of greenery and fresh air. You will hear about the world all the time. Wi-Fi is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best university for the M.Sc. in Botany course.
reviews.review_text: There are no problems with electricity, Wi-Fi is always available, and the quality of the food is excellent. The fitness center is well-maintained, and the gymnasium is excellent. The lab is well maintained, and all equipment is in good working order which helps in learning technical skills. Classrooms are equipped with all the facilities that students need during class time, such as Wi-Fi.

review_content.Placements: Every year, students of M.Sc in the Physics department of our university. We got an impressive average salary package of 7 LPA. Students work as quantitative analysts, medical physicists, software engineers, data scientists, computational physicists, professors in various fields like finance and IT sectors, academia, research and development institutes, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Absolutely top class facilities and Infrastructure were provided by our university to the students. There were thirteen hostels in our university campus, six for boys and the remaining seven for girls. The overall environment of our university campus was very calm and study friendly. Large seminar halls, auditoriums, and projector classrooms were available in our university campus.

review_content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure of our university is really good. High-speed Wi-Fi access is available across our entire university campus. Our university canteen also provides us with very tasty and hygienic food.

individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, nice placements, and a huge campus. It is recommended.

content.Placements: Placements are good but not the best. The RCC (Rollwala Computer Center) is considered the best college for MCA by ACPC, in terms of rank cut-off. The average package offered ranges from 4.5-5 LPA. The highest package offered ranges from 6-8 LPA. The lowest package offered ranges from 2.5-3 LPA. So I will consider it has good placements for the MCA course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. It has a newly constructed building and nice labs. Classrooms are modern with a projector. Hostel facility is provided by the university at a cost of Rs. 1,500 per year (government). So it is also very good. There is a library in the building.

individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied, and it is one of the best government colleges in Bhubaneswar.

content.Placements: The percentage of placement is 40%, and the highest package offered is 3.5 LPA. The companies are usually telecom companies. Many internships are consulted by them, too. They prepare students for real-world challenges, and it helps in the future, so it is pretty good.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are very clean and well-maintained, and some classes have monitors. There are computer labs. Hostels are very clean and well-maintained. Hostel food is average. There is Wi-Fi also and a digital library with computers too. The college creates very good decorum.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: An institution that gives you the best job opportunities.

content.Placements: Every year, students of M.Sc in the Physics department of our university. We got an impressive average salary package of 7 LPA. Students work as quantitative analysts, medical physicists, software engineers, data scientists, computational physicists, professors in various fields like finance and IT sectors, academia, research and development institutes, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Absolutely top class facilities and Infrastructure were provided by our university to the students. There were thirteen hostels in our university campus, six for boys and the remaining seven for girls. The overall environment of our university campus was very calm and study friendly. Large seminar halls, auditoriums, and projector classrooms were available in our university campus.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. (Geography) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My two years of experience at Utkal University.

content.Placements: Students of M.A. in Geography at our university get an average salary package of 5 LPA every year. Students work as cartographers, urban planners, surveyors, professors, researchers in various institutions like universities, research institutes, NGOs, non-profit organisations, government agencies, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure of our university is really good. High-speed Wi-Fi access is available across our entire university campus. Other facilities, like a well-equipped library, smart and air-conditioned classrooms, and specialised laboratories, are also provided to the students by our university. Our university canteen also provides us with very tasty and hygienic food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college and faculty members.

content.Placements: The placement facility is overall good. Placement classes are given from the second year to prepare students. Placement drives come to the college every year. Many reputed companies come here for placement drives, such as Infosys, LTI, Mindtree, and Capgemini.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is good. There are many biotechnology labs, biochemistry labs, microbiology labs, tissue culture labs, molecular biology labs, and cell biology labs with multiple lab equipment. Hostel and transport facilities are available. Food is also available.

faqs.question: How can I take admission to Utkal University B.Ed?
faqs.answer: Go through the eligibility criteria thoroughly and check whether you’re eligible for admission or not. In order to be eligible, a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate (55% for BE/BTech degree holders) is required. If you fulfil eligibility conditions, fill out the application form online (utkaluniversity.ac.in). After form submission, admit card will be issued. Take the Utkal University Entrance Test and secure good marks. Further, a seat is allotted on the basis of academic records

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to B.Ed at Utkal University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not valid for B.Ed course at Utkal University. Candidates willing to get admission to B.Ed course must qualify for Utkal University Entrance Test. The university will evaluate candidates based on their past academic records and scores of entrance test. However, the reservation policy of the Government of Odisha is applicable for admission to B.Ed courses. For more details around the same candidates are advised to visit the university's admission office.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Ed at Utkal University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee ranges between INR 1,100 – INR 80,200. This fee is however as per the data available on official sources and hence, is subject to changes. Over 10 colleges affiliated with the university offer B.Ed courses. The fees at the affiliated colleges can vary. The total admission fee further also varies as the total course fee shall include many other components. Candidates are advised to visit the official website to get more details around Utkal University B.Ed fee structure.

faqs.question: Is the B.Ed course available at Utkal University?
faqs.answer: Yes, a two-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) course is offered by the university. It is offered as a full-time self-financed degree course under the University Department of Teacher Education. The seat intake for the course is 50. Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree with a 50% aggregate are eligible to apply for this course.

faqs.question: What is the fees structure of MBA at Utkal University?
faqs.answer: The Utkal University MBA fee ranges INR 288 to INR 4 lakh. This fee range includes the tuition fee for MBA (Regular), IMBA, E-MBA and other MBA courses. This fee is given as per the data available on the official sources and hence, is subject to change. Other than the tuition fees, candidates also have to pay for Laboratory development fee, Mess charges, Alumni fees, etc. There are nearly 12 Utkal University-affiliated colleges that offer MBAs. The fee payment has to be done at the time of admission followed by fee payment in the semesters.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for Utkal University BBA?
faqs.answer: Utkal University's application fee is INR 600.. Once candidates have paid the application fee and some amount of the tuition fee, their admission is confirmed for the programme.

review_summary.college_name: Sumandeep Vidyapeeth Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely amazing experience to date, from academics to extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: In my batch, there are 250 students currently pursuing MBBS. Since it is the medical field, we don't have recruiting companies. Instead, we get residency in hospitals. In our college, the highest payout is 1.5 LPA. Almost 99% of students get internships. The top role offered is MO (Medical Officer).
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well-constructed, especially the reading rooms, lecture halls, practical labs, demo labs, student mentor counseling rooms, and hostels. The entire campus has Wi-Fi accessibility. The quality of the hostel is 9/10, food is 8/10, medical facilities are 9/10, and sports and games are 10/10.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely best faculty and good placement in 2024 .

content.Placements: The college provides the best placements, with an average package of at least Rs. 40,000 per month, and the highest being Rs. 1 lakh per month. Senior nurses already 100% of students are admission every year, with 100 seats available per year. They provide hospital duty and learn with the patient. Every teacher provides knowledge
content.Infrastructure: Best skill lab provide and in which present best facilities The hostel is unbelievable Like- 4 time food provides Double bedrooms available in the hostel In the college campus hospital present Indoor and outdoor stadium available Canteen facility are present .

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College life is fun everywhere.

content.Placements: As we know, the MBBS provides internships of 1-year in a college. After the internship, jobs are provided to doctors. There is a hospital named Dheeraj, which is a very good hospital in Vadodara. This internship scheme provides a good salary to doctors, about Rs.15,000.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is good and well-furnished. The bathroom is great and modern. Everything else is also very good, and I enjoy being here. There are 7 floors in the hostel, and mainly 300 students are there who are living in same. Hostel life is so chill, I like it so much, and I am very glad that I am here.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Empowering minds that shape the future with knowledge and innovation.

content.Placements: The total strength of my class is 100 students. The average package offered in my course is Rs. 15,000 per month. The top recruiting company is Dhiraj Hospital, which is on the campus. Every student gets an opportunity to join Dhiraj Hospital with a salary of 15,000.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure include a 24-hour campus library with a large number of resources available, and classrooms are equipped with projectors and smart boards to make the topics interesting. The campus also includes a mess for hostelites and a canteen for other students, with large numbers of options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: We had great memories and were hardly satisfied with the campus placements.

content.Placements: In our batch, everyone gets an opportunity to join the campus side in hospitals as well as in colleges for teaching. The starting salary offered is Rs. 18,000 per month which is sufficient for different hospitals as freshers. Internships take place on campus hospitals only.
content.Infrastructure: We have different laboratories according to the particular subject along with campus Wi-Fi. Classrooms are well-ventilated and have modern teaching equipment like projectors which makes the study interesting and easy. We have a campus library with centralized air conditioning with a large number of occupancy and 24/7 open. The food inside the mess is also hygienic and well-prepared.

review_summary.college_name: Gopal Narayan Singh University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Discontinue (Oct 2025) - Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, my experience of college life here is amazing, and I have learned many things.

content.Placements: Around 40% of students from my batch appeared for placement, and around 35% of students got placed. 2.5 LPA to 4 LPA is the package offered. Recruiting companies are Mahindra, Byju's, banks, ITC, etc. Internships are provided for the same university as well as other companies like Dalmia Cement Sudha, etc. Roles offered are business development, admission counseling, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms have facilities provided that were very good, like whiteboards, projectors, an easily accessible library, and computer labs are also provided for several subjects, and extra computer skills are also taught. The quality of food in the hostel mess is pretty hygienic, and good medical facilities are also provided for those in need.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharma.D.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Narayan Institute of Pharmacy: Absolutely satisfied with the overall experience, excellent.

content.Placements: The college has top faculty members, the best behavior, and a cooperative culture. There is a maximum placement rate in pharmacy companies. Ex-students also qualify for GPAT. College placement in a maximum company. Enjoying my course 100% satisfied. Free of ragging, the special disciplinary committee has zero tolerance for ragging and is overall excellent.
content.Infrastructure: Well-equipped labs are separate. Computer labs. No rush in classes. Wi-fi and CCTV camera-equipped classes. Badminton and basketball courts are available. Regular maintenance of the projector is available in class. Good condition sitting facility. Hostel rooms are regularly cleaned. Hygienic mess. Overall, the infrastructure is awesome.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A college with affordable fees and good infrastructure, having trained professionals for teaching.

content.Placements: The placement opportunities for the Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) course at this college are moderately satisfactory, with room for improvement. Most students secure jobs through clinical internships or referrals during their final year, rather than through formal placement drives. The average starting salary ranges between 15,000 to 25,000 per month, depending on the location and organisation. A few students may receive offers from private clinics or hospitals.
content.Infrastructure: The BPT course infrastructure in the college is well-developed. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with AV aids. Labs are modern, especially for anatomy and exercise therapy. The library is resourceful. Clinical training facilities and tie-ups with hospitals are strong.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinue (Oct 2025) - B.Sc. in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In private colleges in Bihar, GNSU is the best university.

content.Placements: The placement cell is good and helpful. They also train students and make them ready to present themselves to companies. The placement cell faculty members are also too good and supportive. But they generally attract private companies or organizations. The package is average, but according to students' capabilities, they try to give their 100 percent. The placement ratio is also good. Last year, they placed about 70 students out of 100.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good. Labs and the library are also student-friendly. Classrooms are comfortable and attached to technology. The hostel is also good, with facilities like electricity, water, and a lift available 24/7. The mess is also good and hygienic, but the quality of food in taste is not valuable.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Offers good infrastructure and experiences in terms of education and events as well.

content.Placements: About 30-40% percent students are placed with the average package of 3 LPA. The top roles offered by companies are Python Developer, Front Developer, and Full Stack Developer. I really have no idea about the least package, but recently one of my seniors got placed in a company with an annual package of 12 LPA. Recently, I have an internship from a company named Codexintern and worked there as a Python intern.
content.Infrastructure: It provides good facilities to students, such as well-maintained hostels, timely fooding service, etc. In terms of studies and all, it is good as well. It provides free Wi-Fi for IT students, computer lab to use anytime, etc. It also has a well-developed and hygienic environment and well-developed medical facilities.

paragraphs: As per the Management NIRF report 2024 released by Gopal Narayan Singh University, the median package offered during MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 3.5 LPA . Further, a total of 36 students were placed out of total 48 students during MBA placements 2023. Apart from this, as per the Pharmacy and Law NIRF reports 2024, the median package offered during BPharm and LLB placements 2023 stood at INR 2.6 LPA and INR 0.5 LPA , respectively.

Earlier, according to the NIRF report 2023, a total of 204 out of 272 UG and PG students were placed during Gopal Narayan Singh University placements 2022 . The median package offered to LLB and MBA students was INR 50,000 and INR 3.80 LPA during placements 2022 .

reviews.review_heading: Overall, my experience of college life here is amazing, and I have learned many things.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have facilities provided that were very good, like whiteboards, projectors, an easily accessible library, and computer labs are also provided for several subjects, and extra computer skills are also taught. The quality of food in the hostel mess is pretty hygienic, and good medical facilities are also provided for those in need.

reviews.review_heading: Narayan Institute of Pharmacy: Absolutely satisfied with the overall experience, excellent.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped labs are separate. Computer labs. No rush in classes. Wi-fi and CCTV camera-equipped classes. Badminton and basketball courts are available. Regular maintenance of the projector is available in class. Good condition sitting facility. Hostel rooms are regularly cleaned. Hygienic mess. Overall, the infrastructure is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: A college with affordable fees and good infrastructure, having trained professionals for teaching.
reviews.review_text: The BPT course infrastructure in the college is well-developed. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with AV aids. Labs are modern, especially for anatomy and exercise therapy. The library is resourceful. Clinical training facilities and tie-ups with hospitals are strong.

reviews.review_heading: In private colleges in Bihar, GNSU is the best university.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good. Labs and the library are also student-friendly. Classrooms are comfortable and attached to technology. The hostel is also good, with facilities like electricity, water, and a lift available 24/7. The mess is also good and hygienic, but the quality of food in taste is not valuable.

reviews.review_heading: Offers good infrastructure and experiences in terms of education and events as well.
reviews.review_text: It provides good facilities to students, such as well-maintained hostels, timely fooding service, etc. In terms of studies and all, it is good as well. It provides free Wi-Fi for IT students, computer lab to use anytime, etc. It also has a well-developed and hygienic environment and well-developed medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: You won't love the lecture.
reviews.review_text:
The facilities and infrastructure available in my college include the library, labs, classrooms, and online tools to teach students.
The quality of facilities in my hostel is very bad because the owner of the hostel provides bad food and rudely talks to students.

reviews.review_heading: The university which is the future of Bihar.
reviews.review_text:
Yes, labs are available in very good quality. Every piece of equipment is available for the experiments. Each piece of equipment is available for each student. 
Sometimes foods are very bad in taste but sometimes they make good quality food. Staff and the warden of the hostel are very friendly .

reviews.review_heading: It is currently an underrated college, but it has great capabilities to expand.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are seriously good. I can totally claim that the mess of the hostel offers the best food compared to others. The medical facilities are also good; the university has its own hospital with a good infrastructure, and manpower and technology availability are also satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In our hostel, I stayed in a 4-seater room, which has many facilities like 24-hour electricity and fresh mineral water. The meal quality is moderately good. The registration process in hostels is that we have to fill out the hostel form and contact the hostel in charge.

reviews.review_heading: Even after the Agriculture course started in May 2019, the facilities here are quite good.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. The infrastructure is very good. Almost 4-5 hostel messes and 2-3 canteens are available in our university. Many types of facilities are available in this university. The university also has its own hospital, which is a very good thing. If you get sick, you don't have to go anywhere else.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: There are so many courses available in my university. It consists of classrooms and a library. Good facilities are available in my hostel, and they maintain proper hygiene. They provide food at low prices because poor students also take admission in this college. Medical facilities and sports are also available.

reviews.review_heading: All facilities are good but some teacher's behaviour are very rude.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available for study like- skill lab, foundation of nursing lab, community health nursing lab, computer lab, common room for boys and girls, library, visitor room, sick room. Ten lecturer rooms for teaching. The university's own hospital is available for proper training.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: A moot court and a computer lab are available. We have a mess and a library. The quality of the food is good. Digital classrooms are available. The university provides free medical checkups for the students who reside on the hostel campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gopal Narayan Singh University.
reviews.review_text: Computer labs and a library are available. There is one moot court area. A playground for various activities, including NCC. Everything is good. Medical facilities are available. The quality of the food is good, but the taste is average, especially on Monday and Tuesday.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college, but its management needs to improve more.
reviews.review_text: Labs are available to do each type of experiment. Classrooms are well maintained. They have projectors. It has a well-stocked library with all types of books related to the course. The hostel rooms are good. The food changes with the seasons.

individual_reviews.course: Post Basic B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Really good teachers are present, but office politics.

content.Placements: I was in this college from 2023 to 2025. I completed a post-basic B.Sc. in nursing from this college. A total of 30 students were in my batch. The highest package was for teaching jobs, and the lowest package was for clinical jobs. The college supported each student to get placed by offering a job without a bond.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, all labs, and classrooms were well-equipped with projectors, and a simulation lab was also present. I didn't live at the hostel, so I don't know, but the canteen was present. Medical facilities were provided by Bharati Hospital, Sangli, and annual sports were held.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Business System - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College provides good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: I am from the 2025 batch, first year. My course is B.Tech in Computer Science and Business Systems. Around 75%-85% of the students are placed in the last batch of 2025. The highest package offered is 37 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.5 LPA. Talking about recruiting companies for my course, they are mainly banking companies like HDFC, Capgemini, etc. Around 50% of the students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The classroom facilities include one blackboard and two smartboards. Also, the college has a very well-maintained library and labs for every subject. The facilities in the hostel are not so good, as the water leaks many times. The quality of food in the hostel is average, but the taste is the worst. But the Back Market is a popular street food place in Pune.

The top recruiting companies of the course are like Capgemini, Infosys, and TCS. The top roles offered in my course are back-end and full-stack developers.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are good, the Wi-Fi is also good, and the classrooms are also good. Libraries of three floors with Wi-Fi available 24 hours. The quality of hostel food is not that good, and also, the sports facilities are there, but not much. Food at the canteen is good, but the food at the mess is not good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelors of Business Administration(BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Bharati Vidyapeeth Delhi for BBA.

content.Placements: BBA course at BVP, the placement picture is decent but realistic. 55 to 60 percent of students in the 3-year UG program got placed in recent years for UG 3-year program at BVP. 51 percent got placed in one year. The median package for the BBA/3-year UG stream is 4.4 LPA. In many cases, the highest reported packages across UG courses at the university reached up to 25 LPA. Though those numbers may pertain to premium streams, not strictly BBA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides a decent range of facilities and infrastructure for both academics and hostel life. The course has well-equipped classrooms with projectors, whiteboards, and Wi-Fi access that help a lot during lectures and presentations. Labs are functional and updated with the required equipment for our practical subjects. The library is quite spacious and has a mix of textbooks, reference material, and a digital section where students can access online journals and e-resources. It's a quiet place to study and spend time between classes. I do not know about the hostel.

paragraphs: Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed to be University Pune admission to all the courses is subject to a valid score in the entrance exam along with the fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria set by the college. Students are required to follow theBharati Vidyapeeth Pune admission processgiven below to get admitted:
Bharati Vidyapeeth Registration 2026

A candidate has to register themselves in Bharati Vidyapeeth's official web portal. Registration for the Bharati Vidyapeeth Common Entrance Test, also known as BVP CET is to be done at the same time. After registration candidates must fill the online application form, pay the fee, and save the form in PDF.
Bharati Vidyapeeth Entrance exam

Once the candidates register, they will have to appear for the entrance test as per the CET scheduled dates. The BVP CET exam is conducted separately for all the offered courses. Once the exam is concluded, it is followed by the results date, counselling date, and college start date.
Bharati Vidyapeeth Result/Counselling

The deemed-to-be university releases results as per the schedule and based on the merit obtained and subject to meeting the minimum eligibility conditions. After the results, the Bharati Vidyapeeth schedules a date for counselling, which candidates must participate in finalising their seats in the university.
Bharati Vidyapeeth Final Admission

The candidate will be provisionally admitted to the programme after paying the course-wise tuition fees are paid. The deemed-to-be university also schedules the college start dates, which usually begin in the month of July.

Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed to be University Pune feesvary depending on the programme. The fee range fromINR 12,000toINR 1.3 crore. The deemed-to-be university also offers multiple seats for its courses. The payment has to be completed through the accepted payment gateway. paragraphs: The highest package offered during Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune placements during the recent placement drive stood at INR 25 LPA whereas the placement rate was recorded at 87% . Moreover, according to Bharati Vidyapeeth NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during UG three-year and UG four-year placements 2023 stood at INR 4.4 LPA and INR 5 LPA , respectively. Further, the median package offered during Bharati Vidyapeeth PG two year placements 2023 was INR 7.2 LPA . There was a rise of over 19% in the UG four year median package in 2023 as compared to 2022. A rise of ~12% was seen in the PG two year median package given in 2023 placements as compared to 2022.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Accountancy - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college with trusted.

content.Placements: Smt. Maniben M. P Shah College of Arts and Commerce for Women has good placements given from the Bafi Bachelor of accounting finance and Insurance department. They are 100 percent trusted for the placement. Students get placement at bank etc. That helps students to get more information about banks, insurance and finance.
content.Infrastructure: There are many courses in the college. College has many circular activities for the students. There are game facilities for indoor and outdoor games like badminton, chess, carrom, cricket and etc. The library is also very big and offers lots of books and in the library there are computers to find information or for presentations.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Usha Mittal Institute Of Technology (SNDT Women's University).

content.Placements: 70-80 percent of students got placed every year. The highest package is 32 LPA by Visa, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA by mass recruiters. Top companies are Visa, Deutsche Bank, Oracle, Barclays, Bank of America, Deloitte, Infosys, etc. Only 10 students get the internship though in third year but almost 30-40 percent of students get internships in fourth year of college in companies like GE Aerospace, Colgate, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of college is good. It's newly renovated. They have a hostel too. It's four sharing and two sharing occupancies. The mess food is average. College has a gym too. They have a basketball court but not many facilities for other sports. You can play badminton in the foyer.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are very helpful. My principal MS Abhilasha Agarwal is also very supportive.

content.Placements: I completed my B.Com from Vanita Vishram College. During our time, there was COVID-19, and although there was a placement opportunity, only about 15 to 20% of students participated. After earning my B.Com, I found roles as an admin and accountant as a fresher. The B.Com program covers various subjects like accounting, environmental studies, economics, and banking, which helped me learn different skills.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were big. There was a good vibe in the library too. I did not stay in the hostel so I cannot tell you about it, but some of my friends stayed there, it is very safe. The canteen area was also big. The food was also good. We did a lot of activities on the college campus. I remember the blood donation camps exactly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Where you will find the three teachers you wanted.

content.Placements: These years, many girl students from different states took admission in Usha Mittal for B.Tech programme. Nearly 80 percent of the students got placed in my course. It is an autonomous college. The academics are pretty chill. 32 LPA is the highest package offered for the CST branch, while 12 LPA could be the average. Companies like Infosys, Visa, Bank of America, and many more have their placement interview here. From the CST branch, almost 80 percent of students get placed in a few good companies. Talking about roles offered, companies like Visa and Infosys do hire students for their highest package.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great college, decent feel, easy life, and good placements.

content.Placements: Software Developer, Software Analyst, Software Engineer, etc., are jobs you can expect here. The placement is quite good. You can see a variety of companies here. The highest package this year is 36 LPA, the lowest is 4.4 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college is decent, not too fancy, but it has 6 labs, 2–3 libraries, a basketball court, clean washrooms, etc. The canteen is also decent. Medical facilities are good. The college has its own sports council, and activities are encouraged here, so no need to worry about that.

admission_overview.college_name: SNDT Mumbai Admission 2025: Eligibility, Fees, Dates, Application

paragraphs: Shreemati Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Women’s University,also known as SNDT University, admissionis both merit and entrance-based. The college acceptsMAH CET, XAT, JEE Main, etc,for admission to the UG and PG courses. The University has three campuses, one each inChurchgate, Santacruz, and Pune. The Juhu campus has more than 15 professional and technical institutions with eight adjoining buildings. The campus offers various PG and PG diploma programmes in different fields such as Engineering, Management, Arts, Education, Technology, Communication, and many more. These courses are offered under 19 different departments, namely the Department of Computer Science, Department of Education Management, Department of Technology, and more.

SNDT Women's University admission is entrance-based to most of its UG and PG courses. Candidates have to meet the basic eligibility requirements of the respective courses to apply for the desired programme. Check below the eligibility criteria, accepting entrance exams, and more for the SNDT College course admissions:
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

SNDT University's fee structuremay include components such as Registration Fee, Tuition Fees, Development Fees, Alumni Fee, etc. Further,SNDT seat allocationis done through the counselling bodies of the respective courses. Check out the SNDT fees and seats for popular UG & PG courses:
*This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

For admission to SNDT University, candidates must complete the entire admission process as per the college's admission guidelines. The process is mainly conducted online, hence, students must apply online at the official website of the university. Before applying for the desired programme, students must fulfil the admission criteria for the same. Find below the step-wise SNDT University admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Candidates must fill out the online application form by visiting the SNDT's official website (sndt.ac.in / https://sndt.digitaluniversity.ac). Once the application form is complete, candidates must take a print-out of the online form, attach Xerox copies of final year mark sheets of the qualifying exam of the applied course, and submit them to the Department Office.
Step 2: SNDT Shortlisting

The application forms are scrutinised based on the eligibility criteria of the course. Once found eligible, the Department will send a Google form link to the registered, eligible candidates via mail to the email addresses provided by the applicant. The candidate must fill out the form as accurately as possible; in case of errors, the application will not be processed further.

Step 3: Merit List and Document Verification:Once the merit list is published, selected candidates will receive notification via phone and email. They will be required to appear in person for document verification. Bring the online application form, original marksheets, and certificates for verification.
Step 4: SNDT Merit list/Final selection

The college releases a merit list of selected candidates. The candidates will be informed the same telephonically as well as via email wherein they will be called offline for document verification along with their online application form and original marksheets & certificates. After document verification, the candidates will proceed to pay the fees with the admin clerk

courses_data.description: Sri Sri University offers full-time BSc and BSc (Hons) courses at the UG level. The university offers BSc (Hons) in Agriculture, Horticulture, Agribusiness and Food, Nutrition & Dietetics. Besides, the university also offers BSc Yoga and BSc Nursing programmes. Candidates can apply for BSc after completing Class 12.

faqs.question: Does SSU offer BSc course?
faqs.answer: SSU offers a full-time UG course of BSc for a duration of three to four years. The university offers this course across specialisations in the fields of Agriculture, Health and wellness, Behavioural Sciences, etc. The total seat intake for Sri University's BSc course is 450, which is inclusive of the seat intake for all BSc specialisations. The university has classified the seat intake for each BSc specialisations.

faqs.question: Is Sri University good for BSC Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Sri University offers a BSc (Hons) course in the specialisation of Agriculture for the duration of four years. For this course, a total 120 seats are offered by the university. During the commencement of this course, the university also provides extracurricular activities for the development of students. The course's curriculum is set in such a way that can help students to make career in both government and private sectors.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam does Sri University accept for BSc?
faqs.answer: For admission to BSc course, Sri University conducts its in-house entrance exam, i.e., SSU CET. This exam is conducted by the university itself for the selection of candidates in UG and PG courses. Apart from this, the university also accepts a valid score of NEET UG for BSc in Nursing and Osteopathy. For admission to BSc in Forensic Science at SSU candidates must have secured a valid scores in SSU CET/JEE Mains/ OJEE etc.

faqs.question: Does Sri University accept JEE score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sri University accepts JEE Main scores for admission to its B.E/B.Tech and B.Arch courses, among other national-level entrance exams such as NATA, CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, and ATMA for various programs including MBA.Apart from the SSU CET, the university also accepts scores of the following entrance exams:JEE Main for B.E/B.Tech coursesNATA for B.Arch coursesCAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, and ATMA for MBA courses

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to BSc courses at Sri Sri University?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for the BSc course at Sri Sri University is candidates must complete their higher senior secondary with a minimum aggregate of 50% from a recognised board of education and Science stream/ relevant stream, as for some of the BSc specialisation the university accepts students from PCB/ PCM stream and for some specialisation the university accepts the students from any relevant stream. Additionally, after applying for the course, candidates must appear in the Sri Sri University in-house entrance test- SSU CET/ NEET. The scores of this mentioned entrance exam are considered to get admission into the BSc course.

faqs.question: Are admissions open at Sri University?
faqs.answer: Sri University admissions are open. Candidates can apply online for the preferred course. The university conducts SSU CET for admission to UG and PG courses. SSU also accepts national-level entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, JEE Main, NATA, etc. for admission to specific courses.

placement_data.title: Sri Sri University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: Sri Sri University has released the MBA placement report 2025 and BTech placement report 2024 . The highest and median package recorded during SSU MBA placement 2025 was INR 15.5 LPA and 6.45 LPA . Further, the average package recorded for undergraduate courses during Sri Sri University placements 2025 was INR 4.3 LPA.

According to the BTech placement data, the highest and average package during Sri Sri University BTech placement 2024 was 10.2 LPA and 5.25 LPA . Top Companies such as TCS, Infosys and Accenture visited the campus in recent past.

In the last 10 years , more than 440 companies visited and 2330 offers were made. The highest package offered was 20 LPA . 1,110 students were placed and 2,100 internships were offered in these placement seasons.

faqs.question: What is the programme outcome after completing B.Sc in Osteopathic from Sri University?
faqs.answer: On completion of the BSc in Osteopathic programme from Sri University, students will be able to: Engage responsively and sensitively in the health care field, by serving patients with the highest quality of osteopathic treatment. Contribute to the development of integrative practices in health care, where osteopathy offers effective and non-invasive alternatives to common chronic and acute conditions. Demonstrate critical reflection in the field of osteopathic research and its applications.

faqs.question: How are the Sri University MBA placements?
faqs.answer: Sri Sri University placement cell has witnessed 98.57% placement in the year 2022. The highest package recorded was INR 13.25 LPA and the average package was INR 6.29 LPA. The popular recruiters for MBA courses at Sri University are Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, etc. As per the latest placement records, the highest package for the Sri Sri University MBA course showed a hike of INR 13.58 LPA in the year 2023.

faqs.question: Does Sri Sri University provide 100% placements for MBA?
faqs.answer: The placement rate recorded during the Sri Sri University MBA placement 2024 was 98%. Further, in the latest placement drive 2025, the highest and average package offered was 15.5 LPA and 7.1 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the MBA placement trend witnessed during Sri University placements?
faqs.answer: The highest package offered during MBA placement 2025 was 15.5 LPA. 14% growth was recorded as compared with last year. In 2024, the highest package was 13.58 LPA. The average package this year increased by 3%. In 2025 and 2024, average package recorded was 7.1 LPA and 6.89 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied due to placement offers.
reviews.review_text: We are being given Wi-Fi in hostel rooms, classrooms, library, and canteens. Classes are air-conditioned with a projector in every classroom. The quality of food served is good and hygienic. Here we have 4 canteens and one mess. The food served is not very spicy but tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Peaceful green campus, supportive faculty members, and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided Wi-Fi and IT infrastructure, classroom and lectures halls, central library - 17,000 books, animation lab, computer lab, agriculture lab, etc. It provided seperate boys and girls hostels. There was a common room in hostel with TV, indoor games, and free Wi-Fi. We had gym and fitness, central dinning hall, mess, and kaivalya kitchen. Total 4 canteens were available. It had ISO certified kitchen.

reviews.review_heading: B.Sc. (hons) agriculture in SSU.
reviews.review_text: Hostel and college infrastructure are great. Hostel is beautiful and lush with greenery all around. The girl's hostel is near the academic building which is very helpful as this proximity means we don't get tired much. But the boys' rooms are very far almost 1 km, so they have to walk to commute to class.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.A. (Hons.) in English course at Sri Sri University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are fairly spacious and good in terms of amenities. The infrastructure is also good. This college follows Indian traditions and culture so all buildings and greenery are very natural and green. The infrastructure is very good in my opinion.

reviews.review_heading: Food is average and all good here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are nearly clean, which gives good experience to learn things when teachers come to explain the new concepts. Hostel facility is good for living. Good room conditions with bathroom and electricity facilities are available. In mess, standard food quality they offer so mostly students don't opt to give mess fee rather, they have outside food sometimes in a week.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good. It's a vegetarian campus so many students may have difficulties.
reviews.review_text: The good library with plenty of books and Wi-Fi is not working properly some of the time, they don't take us to the lab they just make us do the lab in virtual mode. Hostel rooms are normal but the quality of food is very bad. It has a hospital inside the campus and encourages us to participate in different types of sports.

reviews.review_heading: Sri University: Great infrastructure and decent placements, but the faculty needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Sri University offers excellent facilities, including a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, modern labs (computer, design, physics, and electronics), and air-conditioned classrooms with projectors and smart boards. An extensive library with digital resources, sports facilities (cricket, football, basketball, badminton, volleyball), a gym, auditorium, cafeteria, medical facilities with 24/7 ambulance service and well maintained hostels with attached bathrooms and laundry services.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the type of infrastructure and good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in my college include classrooms with strong Wi-Fi connectivity and a library with all kinds of books and study materials. Excellent quality food in both the mess and canteen, excellent medical facilities, and all kinds of sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Overall really good, lack around the faculty response and placements.
reviews.review_text: A good infrastructure overall especially the cyber lab is good. One where you can have access to it any time and also good equipments which are easy to use for the students. Even for those who are not from computer backgrounds can always understand it clear.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, and the teachers are also good. I would like to make changes to syllabus.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 computer labs, and every lab is for each subject, like the solar lab, physics, basic electronics, and math lab. The hostels are the best in the university because they are new buildings. A generator is also there, a lift is also available, 3 time meal, a hospital for medical emergencies with an ambulance, and sports fields too.

reviews.review_heading: Students can come here if they want to get more spiritual and calm alongside their studies.
reviews.review_text: It has all things like a library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. But, I have nearly completed my first year and yet have to go to the lab of the non-IT subjects. We have only done those in virtual labs. The hostel facilities here are good, and meals are great except for a few ones. Our university is a only vegetarian campus. We do have a hospital here but I have not visited any so I am not sure how great they are. For sports, I do not recommend students this place.

reviews.review_heading: Great option if you can work on your skills by yourself. The campus and crowd are great.
reviews.review_text: Our college has amazing green campus and hostels are also good. Hostels have attached washrooms and are not common for multiple rooms. The campus buildings are well-connected. The campus roads are surrounded by trees and plants and greenery. Full points when it comes to campus and hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty members, good placements, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The main thing is the infrastructure. You will be surprised to see that the infrastructure of this university is also very good. After 2 years, the infrastructure is becoming more fantastic.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome faculty members, cyber dojo is the best, alcohol and drugs free campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has 24X7 AC and Wi-Fi. It has best library. Canteen serves awesome food. We have an ayurvedic hospital. We have a badminton court, tennis court, volleyball court, football and cricket ground, and nets for practice. As well as we have table tennis, carrom, and chess and the seniors are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Worth it brother - Habibi come to SSU.
reviews.review_text: You will get a nice library and it's so calm and everything is good. Sports plays a vital role at SSU. Infrastructure at SSU building is great. Like I can't describe it if you visit you will definitely like it. There are 10 hostels, 5 (girls) and 5 (boys). Free gym facility for both boys and girls. As well as you can go for yoga also it's free of cost. As we all know that mess food is not good but still it's good. You will get 3 more cafeterias on the campus.

faqs.answer: A:    No, to pursue the DPharm programme at Swami Devi Dyal Group of Professional Institutions (SDDGPI), candidates must have completed Class 12 with a Science background. The required subjects include Physics, Chemistry, and either Biology or Mathematics. Consequently, as a Commerce student, you do not meet the eligibility criteria for DPharm admission. Steps for Swami Devi Dyal Group of Professional Institutions Admission Process 2025

The admission process for Swami Devi Dyal College is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds, offline admission process, and document verification. A step-by-step process that students need to follow is as follows:
STEP 1: Swami Devi Dyal College Application Process 2025

The application process for all programmes at Swami Devi Dyal College is done online. Candidates can fill out the Swami Devi Dyal College application form 2025 on the official website for the respective course accepting exam as given above. STEP 2: Swami Devi Dyal College Selection Process 2025

Candidates who've applied for any course at Swami Devi Dyal College must appear for the entrance exam or qualifying exam as per the respective course. After qualifying the minimum eligibility criteria. The candidates are shortlisted based on the various entrance exam scores accepted by the college including JEE, NEET, CAT, MAT and others.

faqs.question: How are placements for DPharm programme at SDDGPI?
faqs.answer: Based on the reviews of alumni on Shiksha, here is the information about the placements of SDDGPI for the DPharm programme: Review 1: Placements for the DPharm programme at Swami Devi Dyal Group of Professional Institutions (SDDGPI) are generally positive. Students who graduate with a first division often secure placements. Top companies like Cipla and GSK recruit studnets. The highest salary package offered is around INR 1 Lacs per month, while medium-sized companies offer between INR 20,000 and INR 30,000 per month. Reveiw 2: Many students from the programme also secure internships in various pharmaceutical industries, gaining practical experience and enhancing their employability. The roles offered typically focus on management and marketing within the pharmaceutical field. Overall, while the placement packages can vary, the opportunities provided are valuable for students looking to build their careers in the pharmaceutical sector. Conclusively, placements for the DPharm programme at SDDGPI are generally decent, with companies like Cipla and GSK offering decent salaries to high-performing students. However, salary packages vary widely, and opportunities are particularly strong in management and marketing roles. Internships are providing valuable industry experience. Note: These insights might not fully represent the experience of the entire batch of DPharm course. Due to varying outcomes and opportunities, students are advised to conduct their own research to get a clear understanding of the placement scenario.
